IfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoneyˆIfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoney,ˆpressuringˆyouˆtoˆhandˆitˆover,ˆorˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆyourˆpermission,ˆyou'reˆnotˆalone,ˆandˆweˆcanˆhelp.ˆ##ˆTellˆusˆsafelyˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆwhenˆit'sˆsafe.ˆYouˆcanˆuseˆaˆcodeˆphraseˆlikeˆ"Iˆneedˆtoˆtalkˆaboutˆmyˆaccountˆsecurity"ˆifˆsomeoneˆmightˆseeˆyourˆscreen.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam,ˆwhoˆareˆtrainedˆtoˆhelp.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆdoˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆsignˆoutˆotherˆdevicesˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆreplaceˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆStopˆsendingˆpaperˆmailˆtoˆyourˆaddressˆ-ˆTalkˆaboutˆoptionsˆforˆmovingˆmoneyˆyouˆneedˆtoˆkeepˆsafeˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆwon'tˆdoˆWeˆwon'tˆtellˆanyoneˆelseˆyouˆcontactedˆus.ˆ##ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆimmediateˆdanger,ˆcallˆemergencyˆservicesˆfirst.ˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆfasterˆwhenˆyouˆtellˆusˆit'sˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-scams">
CommonˆscamsˆtoˆwatchˆforˆTheseˆareˆtheˆscamsˆweˆseeˆmostˆoften.ˆKnowingˆthemˆisˆtheˆbestˆprotection.ˆ##ˆFakeˆbankˆcallsˆSomeoneˆcallsˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆTallowbrook'sˆfraudˆteam.ˆTheyˆknowˆsomeˆofˆyourˆdetailsˆandˆsayˆyourˆaccountˆisˆatˆrisk.ˆTheyˆaskˆforˆaˆcodeˆorˆaskˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoney.ˆThat'sˆaˆscam.ˆWeˆneverˆdoˆthat.ˆ##ˆImpersonatingˆsomeoneˆyouˆknowˆAˆmessageˆfromˆaˆ"familyˆmember"ˆwithˆaˆnewˆnumberˆwhoˆurgentlyˆneedsˆmoney.ˆCallˆthemˆonˆtheirˆoldˆnumberˆbeforeˆyouˆsendˆanything.ˆ##ˆMarketplaceˆandˆrentalˆscamsˆAˆsellerˆasksˆyouˆtoˆpayˆbyˆBrookPayˆorˆwireˆinsteadˆofˆaˆprotectedˆpaymentˆmethod,ˆoftenˆforˆaˆdealˆthatˆseemsˆtooˆgood.ˆBrookPayˆandˆwiresˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed.ˆ##ˆJobˆandˆinvestmentˆscamsˆSomeoneˆoffersˆeasyˆmoneyˆforˆmovingˆfundsˆthroughˆyourˆaccount,ˆorˆpromisesˆguaranteedˆreturns.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆforˆothersˆcanˆgetˆyourˆaccountˆclosed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyou'veˆbeenˆscammed,ˆmessageˆusˆstraightˆaway.ˆTheˆsoonerˆweˆknow,ˆtheˆbetterˆtheˆchanceˆofˆstoppingˆorˆrecoveringˆtheˆmoney,ˆalthoughˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆthat.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammer".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-documents">
DocumentsˆthatˆhelpˆaˆdisputeˆTheˆrightˆdocumentsˆmakeˆaˆdisputeˆfasterˆandˆmoreˆlikelyˆtoˆsucceed.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆhelpsˆforˆeachˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆreceivedˆ-ˆOrderˆconfirmationˆshowingˆtheˆexpectedˆdeliveryˆdateˆ-ˆTrackingˆinformation,ˆifˆanyˆ-ˆYourˆmessagesˆtoˆtheˆmerchantˆaskingˆaboutˆtheˆdeliveryˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆasˆdescribedˆ-ˆTheˆproductˆlistingˆorˆdescriptionˆ-ˆPhotosˆofˆwhatˆyouˆreceivedˆ-ˆProofˆyouˆreturnedˆitˆorˆofferedˆto,ˆifˆtheˆmerchantˆaskedˆ##ˆCancelledˆsubscriptionˆstillˆchargedˆ-ˆTheˆcancellationˆconfirmation,ˆorˆaˆscreenshotˆofˆtheˆdateˆyouˆcancelledˆ-ˆTheˆmerchant'sˆcancellationˆterms,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆthemˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆUsuallyˆnothing.ˆJustˆconfirmˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorizeˆtheˆtransactionˆandˆthatˆyourˆcardˆisˆfrozenˆorˆreported.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆuploadˆOpenˆtheˆdisputeˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆtapˆAddˆdocuments.ˆPhotosˆandˆPDFsˆwork.ˆNeverˆsendˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆpasswordsˆasˆpartˆofˆaˆdispute.ˆWeˆdon'tˆneedˆthem.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
